notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but has no separate preview-image field and misuses og:image as an icon fallback.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited only after the initial save, not before it.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are not implemented.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but not notes.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions are implemented.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is hard-coded; users cannot select a sort key.
REF-BM-23: Markdown notes and note rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: Archive/restore behavior is absent, so archive is not distinguished from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
